kicker_prefix: KP4 · Designing Digital Government Services · Module 2
audience: The public-sector manager who commissions a service, judges the offer and accepts the result

videos.title: One catalogue of the sector's services, and the blocks they share
videos.message: List every service the sector's bodies owe once, with what each rests on, before you specify any one of them.

videos.title: Write down what was asked before anyone designs
videos.message: One entry for each separate thing asked, in the customer's words, with where it was said.

videos.title: The records the service keeps, and whose each one is
videos.message: For every fact: we keep it, we take it from another body, or we must not hold it.

videos.title: Every goal named, and each tied to what was asked
videos.message: A service is broken into the goals people have in it; every goal serves an entry and every entry is served by a goal.

videos.title: What every goal may use, and may not invent
videos.message: States, settings and code lists are written once and shared; a goal that needs something missing raises a question.

videos.title: What the service is built on, and what crosses its boundary
videos.message: One document names the platform, the shared blocks it uses and every flow that crosses to another body.
